biggest_catch: Your friend must trade at least $100 of crypto within 30 days — and the $50 each side is paid in cryptocurrency, whose value moves after it is credited.
catches: The referred friend must be a new Gemini user who trades $100 USD or more within the first 30 days; otherwise neither side gets anything.
The $50 bonus is paid in the crypto of your choice — not cash — and its value can move after crediting.
Recruit-tier rewards are paid 32 days after sign-up to confirm legitimate participation.
Recruit-tier payouts are capped at USD $1,500 per user (30 referrals).
Self-referrals, duplicate accounts, and gaming the program are prohibited and can lead to disqualification.
The older Icon/Legend revenue-share tiers were discontinued effective November 24, 2025.

c1.evidence: Gemini — US-based regulated cryptocurrency exchange and custodian; official gemini.com legal referral terms.

c2.evidence: Official Gemini Referral Rewards Program Terms (dated January 20, 2026; current offer from November 24, 2025) state the Recruit tier: referee trades ≥ $100 in first 30 days → $50 referrer + $50 referee for US users; $1,500 payout cap; 32-day payout timing.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate in the referral program.

c4.evidence: Official terms state '$50' rewards for both referrer and referee on the Recruit tier; third-party blogs advertise varying promo amounts ($15/$75), which are older or limited-time offers.

eligibility: Referrer: a Gemini user with a referral invite. Friend: a new Gemini user in an eligible country (US, Hong Kong, New Zealand get $50; EU countries get €20; Australia AUD $50) who trades $100 USD or more within the first 30 days.
notes: Official Gemini Referral Rewards Program Terms reviewed 2026-09-23. Re-audit 2026-09-23: the older $15 blog-post offer is superseded — the current official terms (dated January 20, 2026, effective November 24, 2025) set the US Recruit reward at $50 per side with a $1,500 payout cap and 32-day payout. No Gemini referral routes exist in the catalog (generic promo R0015 and Earn R0354 are not referral routes), so no duplication.
payout_quote: Official Gemini Referral Rewards Program Terms: 'For users that were referred on or after November 24, 2025 @ 12:00 pm EST, the following referral tiers shall apply: Recruit — Referee Trade Requirement (within first 30 days) = USD $100 — Referrer Reward: USD $50 for users in Hong Kong, New Zealand, and the United States — Referee Reward: USD $50 for users in Hong Kong, New Zealand, and the United States.' Timing: 'Recruit Referral: Paid 32 days after sign-up to confirm legitimate participation.' Cap: 'Recruit referral tier has a maximum payout cap of either €1,500 or AUD $1,500 or USD $1,500 depending on your country of residence.'

s1.note: New users only; friend must trade $100+ USD in crypto within the first 30 days; country-specific reward amounts ($50 US/HK/NZ, €20 EU, AUD $50 AU); $1,500 payout cap.

s2.note: $50 in crypto of choice per side — real crypto value, not cash; no upfront fee.

s3.note: Friend must trade $100+ within 30 days of sign-up; rewards paid 32 days after sign-up; trackable in the Rewards Hub.

s4.note: '$50' stated flatly for both sides in the current official terms; the older $15 blog offer is superseded and disclosed as such.

s5.note: https://www.gemini.com/legal/gemini-referral-rewards-program-terms — official Gemini legal terms page, found in search 2026-09-23 (page is JS-rendered on direct load; terms content verified via search-engine crawl of the official page dated January 20, 2026).

s6.note: Steps are concrete: send referral invite, friend opens account and trades $100+ in 30 days, both receive $50 in crypto after 32 days.

steps: Open your Gemini account and send a referral invite to a friend.
Your friend opens a new Gemini account using your invite.
Your friend trades $100 USD or more in crypto within the first 30 days.
32 days after sign-up, both of you receive the $50 bonus in the crypto of your choice.
Track progress in Gemini's Rewards Hub.
timing: Friend must trade $100+ within 30 days of sign-up; rewards paid 32 days after sign-up.
